narr: Multiple rounds of slow-moving showers and thunderstorms developed along a weak frontal boundary. These storms produced locally heavy rainfall from Montgomery County to Anne Arundel County. Rainfall amounts of two to four inches were observed with several hours.
ev: Montgomery County stream gauge showed 7 foot rise in 45 minutes on the Cabin John Stream at 8110 Bradley Boulevard. The road was closed with one foot of water flowing across the road.
